verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS API with official SDKs and MCP servers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out control for AvaTax, its SDKs, or its MCP server, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
